namibia.name: Fish River Canyon
namibia.desc: Southern Namibia's dramatic canyon — Africa's largest and a premier multi-day hike.

namibia.name: Damaraland & Kaokoland
namibia.desc: Desert-adapted elephants, rhino tracking, and Himba culture in the northwest.

namibia.name: Namib-Naukluft
namibia.desc: Sossusvlei's red dunes in one of the world's largest conservation areas.

namibia.name: Swakopmund & Walvis Bay
namibia.desc: Atlantic coast adventure hub — dunes, skydiving, and fresh seafood.

namibia.name: Etosha National Park
namibia.desc: Namibia's premier wildlife sanctuary centred on a vast salt pan.

namibia.name: Kavango & Zambezi
namibia.desc: Lush riverine northeast — hippos, crocs, and mokoro trips near Botswana.

south-africa.name: Western Cape
south-africa.desc: Build a first South Africa trip around Cape Town, the Cape Peninsula, historic wine towns, and the forest-and-lagoon coast of the Garden Route.
south-africa.bestMonths: Nov–Mar for the Cape; Aug–Sep for West Coast flowers

south-africa.name: Gauteng
south-africa.desc: Treat Johannesburg as more than an airport: pair South Africa's modern urban story with Soweto's freedom history and the Cradle of Humankind.
south-africa.bestMonths: Year-round; Apr–May and Sep–Oct are especially comfortable

south-africa.name: Mpumalanga & Kruger Lowveld
south-africa.desc: Combine public self-drive safari in Kruger with the escarpment viewpoints and waterfalls of the Panorama Route.
south-africa.bestMonths: May–Sep for dry-season safari; Panorama Route year-round

south-africa.name: KwaZulu-Natal
south-africa.desc: Link warm Indian Ocean beaches with Zulu heritage, mountain hikes, battlefields, wetlands, reefs, and wildlife along the Elephant Coast.
south-africa.bestMonths: May–Sep for drier coast and hiking conditions

south-africa.name: Eastern Cape
south-africa.desc: Choose malaria-free wildlife around Addo, continue the Garden Route east, or slow down among beaches and Xhosa communities on the Wild Coast.
south-africa.bestMonths: May–Sep for safari; Dec–Mar for the coast

botswana.name: Okavango Delta
botswana.desc: UNESCO wetland — mokoro channels, Moremi, and exclusive concessions.

botswana.name: Chobe & Kasane
botswana.desc: Africa's greatest elephant concentrations along the Chobe River.

botswana.name: Makgadikgadi Pans
botswana.desc: Vast salt pans, meerkats, and zebra migration after rains.

botswana.name: Central Kalahari
botswana.desc: Remote black-maned lions and raw desert wilderness.

zambia.name: Victoria Falls & Livingstone
zambia.desc: The Smoke That Thunders — rafting, flights, and Devil's Pool seasonally.

zambia.name: Luangwa Valley
zambia.desc: Birthplace of the walking safari — leopards and hippo-filled rivers.

zambia.name: Lower Zambezi
zambia.desc: Canoe safaris and escarpment views along the Zambezi.

zambia.name: Kafue & Busanga
zambia.desc: Vast wilderness with cheetah on the Busanga Plains.

zimbabwe.name: Victoria Falls
zimbabwe.desc: Panoramic gorge views, bungee, and rainforest walks on the Zimbabwe side.

zimbabwe.name: Hwange
zimbabwe.desc: Zimbabwe's largest park — legendary elephant herds and predator action.

zimbabwe.name: Mana Pools
zimbabwe.desc: UNESCO Zambezi floodplain — walking safaris among albida trees.

zimbabwe.name: Eastern Highlands
zimbabwe.desc: Cool mountain retreats, trout fishing, and Nyanga vistas.

mozambique.name: Maputo & South Coast
mozambique.desc: Capital culture, fresh prawns, and gateway to southern beaches.

mozambique.name: Bazaruto Archipelago
mozambique.desc: Dugongs, diving, and dhow sails on the Indian Ocean.

mozambique.name: Tofo & Inhambane
mozambique.desc: Whale sharks, relaxed beach lodges, and authentic coastal life.

mozambique.name: Gorongosa & Central
mozambique.desc: Restored wilderness and Mount Gorongosa biodiversity.

mozambique.name: Quirimbas North
mozambique.desc: Remote islands, mangroves, and Swahili-influenced culture.

malawi.name: Lake Malawi South
malawi.desc: Cape Maclear snorkelling, beach lodges, and lakeside villages.

malawi.name: Liwonde & Shire Valley
malawi.desc: Boat safaris with elephants and crocs on the Shire River.

malawi.name: Nyika Plateau
malawi.desc: Rolling grasslands, zebras, and wild orchids at altitude.

malawi.name: Lilongwe & Central
malawi.desc: Capital markets, craft centres, and gateway to the lake.

lesotho.name: Sani Pass & Drakensberg
lesotho.desc: Iconic 4x4 pass and highest pub in Africa at the summit.

lesotho.name: Malealea & Highlands
lesotho.desc: Pony trekking through Basotho villages and mountain valleys.

lesotho.name: Afriski & Oxbow
lesotho.desc: Winter skiing and summer mountain biking on the plateau.

lesotho.name: Katse Dam & Bokong
lesotho.desc: Engineering marvel and plateau vulture viewpoints.

eswatini.name: Hlane & Lowveld
eswatini.desc: Lions, rhinos, and big game in royal bushveld.

eswatini.name: Mlilwane Sanctuary
eswatini.desc: Walk and cycle among antelope — Eswatini's pioneer reserve.

eswatini.name: Ezulwini Valley
eswatini.desc: Craft markets, cultural villages, and valley lodges near Mbabane.

eswatini.name: Malolotja Highlands
eswatini.desc: Canopy tours, hiking trails, and montane wilderness.
